document.title: ESP32_DevKitC_V4
document.extraction_method: manual visual extraction from rendered PDF page 1 plus parsed schematic text
limitations: Pin roles for discrete transistors Q1/Q2 are inferred from the NPN symbol and the printed auto-program truth table.
U3 is explicitly marked NC/not populated; its pin-to-net entries are retained as alternate footprint information but should not be treated as assembled electrical connections.
Unlabeled intermediate nets were assigned synthetic names such as LED_EXT5V_R2_D1, CP2102_VBUS_SENSE, U1_RST, and ACTIVE.

power_rails.description: Raw USB connector VBUS before Schottky diode and CP2102 VBUS-sense divider.
Board 5V rail; fed from USB VBUS through D3 and exposed on header J2. Feeds U2 regulator input.
3.3V rail generated by U2 AMS1117-3.3; powers ESP32 module and CP2102N.

R2.description: Series resistor for red power LED

D1.description: Power indicator LED from EXT_5V through R2 to ground

D3.description: USB VBUS to EXT_5V feed diode; blocks back-power toward USB
